original: advayasamatāvijaye mahākalparāje sarvamantrasamuccayo nāma samādhipaṭalaḥ ekaviṃśatimaḥ samāptaḥ ||

bodhi svabhāvāḥ samprāptāḥ bodhisattvāḥ viśāradāḥ
ākāśa dhātu sampūrṇāḥ bhogāḥ vajra bodhi pratiṣṭhitāḥ

original: alakṣaṇeṣu dharmeṣu prapañco na hi vidyate |
